note: Validated mirror of the implemented framework contract, not a runtime configuration or a project override. SKILL.md is authoritative for phases; research.py implements the remaining enums.

phases.name: scope
phases.goal: Bound the research question and constraints
phases.exit_criteria: Question, significance, feasibility and success standards are sufficiently defined

phases.name: ideation
phases.exit_criteria: The core selects a testable hypothesis or explains why scope must change

phases.name: design
phases.exit_criteria: Protocol, comparisons, uncertainty and required resources are specified or redesign is justified

phases.name: execute
phases.exit_criteria: Results and failures are preserved and sufficient for synthesis, or redesign is justified

phases.name: synthesize
phases.exit_criteria: Claims and limits are assessed and the next direction is justified

phases.name: write
phases.exit_criteria: The requested draft is traceable and reviewable, or evidence gaps require rework

phases.name: review
phases.exit_criteria: Issues are resolved or routed back; closure requires valid evidence and final audits

phases.name: complete
phases.exit_criteria: Reopening requires a new core scope decision
